EQL cup is the first short version of a tournament held by EQL. The idea is to facilitate some QuakeWorld action in a fast paced competition ahead of the christmas holidays. The tournament started the 26th of November and will end the 21st of December. The previous versions of EQL have either been in a league format with an extensive group stage ending in playoffs or a ladder spanning over several months.
